parsed.rationale: Two of the four participating records live in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' (package: Artwork), which is a test file. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing even one test-marked record must be treated as a test-fixture and no refactor action taken. The two CGImage extensions at lines 61 and 91 of ArtworkServiceTests.swift are test-support helpers; lifting them into the production Core package would couple production image-compatibility code to test semantics. The two Image extensions in 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/ImageCompatability.swift' may themselves warrant consolidation, but that cannot be evaluated in isolation from the CGImage extensions without separating the cluster, which is outside the scope of a single-cluster recommendation.
